Name: Redstone Dust (Adds a new path)
Author: arcipisces
Description:
This mod adds a new path type that visually resembles Redstone Dust.
It’s perfect for players using Automate, creating a glowing network effect between machines.
✨ Features[list]
[*]Buy the [b]Redstone Path recipe[/b] from [b]Robin’s shop[/b]
[*]Two selectable designs:
[list]
[*][i]Classic[/i] — pixel-dusted edges
[*][i]Modern[/i] — solid and bold look
[/list][*]Works with Automate (purely visual)
[*]No gameplay changes
[/list]⚙️ Requirements[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[/list][i](Automate is optional — but highly recommended!)[/i]
